description: Design and implement a proper multi-signal ranking engine in backend/src/modules/posts/recommendation.service.js and integrate it into post.service.js for both Home Feed and Explore. Replace the current simplistic latest-first approach with a configurable, extensible scoring system.
steps: Rewrite backend/src/modules/posts/recommendation.service.js with a new ranking engine architecture: (1) Define a SIGNAL_WEIGHTS config object (admin-configurable via AppConfig) with weights for: likes, saves (highest), shares, comments, views, creatorFollowers, creatorQuality, verification, freshness, diversity, exploration, randomness, newCreatorBoost. (2) Implement a scorePost() function that computes a composite score from all available signals. (3) Implement freshness decay: use a time-decay function (e.g., gravity/exponential decay) where score decreases as post ages. (4) Implement diversity logic: track seen creator IDs and penalize consecutive posts from the same creator. (5) Implement exploration: reserve a percentage of slots for random/new content the user has not interacted with. (6) Implement new creator boost: creators with fewer than N posts or accounts younger than M days get a score multiplier. (7) Implement creator quality signal: based on average engagement rate across their posts. (8) Make the engine pluggable: use a signal registry pattern where new signals can be added without modifying core scoring logic.

Update buildRecommendedFeed() in recommendation.service.js to use the new scoring engine for Home Feed: priorities are engagement > saves > recent > creator quality > exploration. Ensure no consecutive posts from the same creator. Apply the 70/20/10 split concept but for home feed: ~70% engagement-weighted, ~20% preference-matched, ~10% exploration/fresh.

Create a new buildExploreFeed() function in recommendation.service.js specifically for Explore: ~70% engagement-weighted (trending), ~20% established/verified creators, ~10% fresh uploads from new creators. Include diversity and randomness to prevent repetition.

Update getExplore() in backend/src/modules/posts/post.service.js to call the new buildExploreFeed() for ranked explore (when no search/filter is active), falling back to the existing latest-first for search queries.
Update DEFAULT_WEIGHTS to include all new signal weights with sensible defaults. Ensure backward compatibility with existing AppConfig entries.
Validate both files parse correctly with node --check
acceptance_criteria: Scoring engine uses multiple signals: likes, saves, comments, freshness decay, creator quality, verification, new creator boost, diversity, exploration, randomness
Saves have the highest weight among engagement signals
No consecutive posts from the same creator in the feed output
New creators (few posts or young accounts) get a boost
Engine is pluggable: new signals can be added by registering a function without modifying core scoring
Falls back gracefully if signals are unavailable (e.g., no views count yet)
Both files pass node --check syntax validation
Existing feed API contract (data + meta with cursor pagination) is preserved
verification: Review code confirms signal registry pattern and configurable weights
